label: Search knowledge
description: Finds the passages of a knowledge base (documents you uploaded on the Knowledge page) that best answer a question, and saves them in a data field, each with its title, page and a citation number to quote.

outputs.name: next
outputs.description: Where to go after the search: connect the next step (usually an AI step that answers from the passages), or Finish.

knowledge_base.title: Knowledge base
knowledge_base.description: The name of a knowledge base in this project (Knowledge page). Exports ship it as knowledge/<name>.jsonl.

query.title: Search for
query.description: Jinja template: the question to look up.

mode.title: Match by
mode.description: hybrid = words and meaning together (best in most cases); semantic = meaning (embeddings); keyword = exact words (BM25)

min_score.title: Minimum score
min_score.description: Drop passages scoring below this (0 = keep the best ones whatever their score)

output.title: Save the passages in
output.description: A list of {cite, title, text, page, source, score}; an AI step can quote them by [cite]

sources_output.title: Save the sources in
sources_output.description: Optional: the citation list ({cite, title, source, page}) to show under an answer
